svg.title: J6: labeled pins, native PCB top view
svg.desc: Gold U means unassigned. Red exclamation means GND required but NC in saved CAD. Purple question mark means grounding review for FB2 marked NC in saved CAD. Gray A means assigned on a net with routing gaps, green A means assigned on a connected net. Pad centers follow native PCB coordinates.
